sentences.en: A valuable object decreases in value if it is damaged.
sentences.zh: 一个受损的价值高的物品会贬值。

sentences.en: We must be able to discriminate between objects and situations.
sentences.zh: 我们必须能够区分物体和情境。

sentences.en: Your mother will probably object to your climbing the mountain.
sentences.zh: 你妈妈可能会反对你爬山。

mnemonic: 词根记忆：ob（反）+ject（扔）→反向扔→反对
